svg.title: Compare Retained Yield Before Operating Costs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-retained-yield; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Yield Before Operating Costs; subtitle: Five illustrative product spreads reconcile to the 65% retained-share anchor.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are retained-contribution percentages, not owner profit margins or observed market quotes. Assigning $135,000 annual gross billings to each of five niches creates an illustrative equal-weight Base mix totaling $675,000.; caption: Retained contributions total $91,800 + $83,700 + $101,250 + $74,250 + $87,750 = $438,750. The weighted retained yield is 65%; payment-processing and other operating costs remain below this measure. Actual product mixes require fresh supplier quotes.; stages: label: H100 and H200 reservations; value: 68% retained yield on authorized GPU-hour resale; numeric value: 68.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $43,200 and retained contribution is $91,800. Prefer prepaid business balances; idle reserved hours still consume cash.; label: B200 capacity windows; value: 62% retained yield on bounded accelerated-compute windows; numeric value: 62.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $51,300 and retained contribution is $83,700. Match customer reservation terms to supply; benchmark before promising throughput.; label: Multi-provider inference; value: 75% retained yield on normalized delivered inference; numeric value: 75.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $33,750 and retained contribution is $101,250. Meter input, output, cache, and retries separately before debiting prepaid credits.; label: SIP and business messaging; value: 55% retained yield after carrier and messaging charges; numeric value: 55.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $60,750 and retained contribution is $74,250. Include carrier surcharges and registration costs consistently; restrict high-cost destinations and abnormal traffic.; label: Authorized IPv4 leasing; value: 65% retained yield on documented address-capacity leases; numeric value: 65.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $47,250 and retained contribution is $87,750. Verify lease authority, routing authorization, abuse history, and return conditions before accepting customer funds.

text.title: Compare Retained Yield Before Operating Costs
text.tspan: Compare Retained Yield Before Operating Costs

circle.title: label: H100 and H200 reservations; value: 68% retained yield on authorized GPU-hour resale; numeric value: 68.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $43,200 and retained contribution is $91,800. Prefer prepaid business balances; idle reserved hours still consume cash.

label: B200 capacity windows; value: 62% retained yield on bounded accelerated-compute windows; numeric value: 62.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $51,300 and retained contribution is $83,700. Match customer reservation terms to supply; benchmark before promising throughput.

label: Multi-provider inference; value: 75% retained yield on normalized delivered inference; numeric value: 75.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $33,750 and retained contribution is $101,250. Meter input, output, cache, and retries separately before debiting prepaid credits.

label: SIP and business messaging; value: 55% retained yield after carrier and messaging charges; numeric value: 55.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $60,750 and retained contribution is $74,250. Include carrier surcharges and registration costs consistently; restrict high-cost destinations and abnormal traffic.

label: Authorized IPv4 leasing; value: 65% retained yield on documented address-capacity leases; numeric value: 65.0; detail: At $135,000 gross billings, upstream cost is $47,250 and retained contribution is $87,750. Verify lease authority, routing authorization, abuse history, and return conditions before accepting customer funds.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are retained-contribution percentages, not owner profit margins or observed market quotes. Assigning $135,000 annual gross billings to each of five niches creates an illustrative equal-weight Base mix totaling $675,000.
